$comment: FROZEN. Curated catalog of representative requests recorded as the Express→FastAPI parity baseline (tasks/chief/30-api-shell-parity.json US-1). It was replayed by scripts/record-parity-fixtures.ts, which wrote contracts/parity/fixtures/<id>.json; that script retired with the Express app in tasks/chief/80-cutover.json US-2, so this catalog and its fixtures no longer have a recorder and are history rather than input. The rules it was authored under, kept here because they explain what the fixtures are: every entry is side-effect free (a read, or a write rejected at validation before it reaches a store) — which is why services/api/tests/test_parity_replay.py can safely replay them against the live corpus; ids used in paths are stable corpus rows; `route` is the Express template the entry exercises, and is what links the fixture to its operation in openapi.json. GET /api/openapi.json is deliberately NOT here — the served document is asserted byte-equal against docs/openapi.json (by server/services/openapi-spec.test.ts then, by services/api/tests/test_openapi_document.py now), and recording the shape of a whole OpenAPI document costs ~70 KB for no extra signal.
